description: Solo builder at UAB (Computer Science) tackling the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge! I am developing an autonomous astronaut health-monitoring platform for deep-space missions. Combining real-time biometric telemetry simulation, physiological risk scoring (radiation, cardiovascular, and bone density stress), and an AI-powered medical triage copilot, this tool empowers crews to self-diagnose and act without Earth-based latency. Built end-to-end with Next.js, FastAPI, and AI.
summary: ASTRA-MED is an autonomous astronaut health-monitoring and clinical decision-support platform designed for deep-space exploration. Addressing the severe communication latencies of long-duration missions (up to 20+ minutes one-way from Earth), ASTRA-MED empowers crew members to independently monitor health telemetry, evaluate multi-system risks mapped to NASA's Human Research Program (HRP) hazards, perform guided self-exams via an interactive body telemetry map, analyze diagnostic scans, and execute safety-guarded countermeasures guided by an AI Flight Surgeon Copilot.
details:
What does it do & How does it work?
ASTRA-MED is a mission-critical web application that bridges the gap between complex physiological data and actionable space medicine. It features:

  • Interactive Clickable Astronaut Body Map: Highlights 5 critical systems (Neuro-Ocular/SANS, Cardiovascular, Skeletal/Muscular, Immune/Metabolic, and Radiation Shielding) with plain-language self-exam guides and step-by-step instructions.
  • Multi-Environment Hazard Simulator: Instantly switches between Deep-Space Transit, ISS, Lunar Base, and Mars Rover contexts, mapping anomalies directly to NASA's 5 HRP Spaceflight Hazards.
  • Diagnostic Scan & Symptom Analyzer: Supports image uploads (such as ocular ultrasounds or dermal rashes) for AI-assisted physiological triage.
  • Safety-Guarded AI Flight Surgeon Copilot: Delivers structured, NASA-aligned intervention checklists while strictly enforcing clinical safety guardrails (requiring flight surgeon sign-off for treatments).
  • Readiness Gamification: Tracks persistent mission streaks, countermeasure adherence, and resilience badges.

Benefits & Intended Impact
By enabling autonomous medical self-sufficiency, ASTRA-MED ensures that deep-space crews can detect and mitigate health risks (such as bone loss, cardiovascular strain, and acute radiation sickness) immediately without waiting for ground-based medical consultation.
Technology Stack

  • Frontend & Visualization: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS (Glassmorphic Mission Control UI), Recharts, Lucide Icons.
  • AI & Clinical Logic: Integrated LLM reasoning engine conditioned on NASA Human Research Program thresholds and ISS countermeasure protocols.
